name: Webmail (Thunderbird-style)
description: Thunderbird-style three-pane webmail for IMAP/POP3/SMTP accounts, served by a local Rust mail backend.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; frame-src 'self'; form-action 'none'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:*
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; connect-src 'none'; img-src data:; font-src 'none'; media-src 'none'; worker-src 'none'
